fact: Comores Câbles states on its own undated corporate page that the 2Africa submarine cable has been put into service; the page lists EASSy and FLY-LION3 as regional systems without saying they land in Comoros. Date is the page's published proxy year 2026, as the page gives none.

Huawei Marine announced it delivered the 260km Avassa submarine cable for Comoros Telecom and Mayotte carrier STOI, linking Grande Comore, Anjouan and Mayotte, described as the second international submarine cable between Comoros and Mayotte and as securing Comoros' international gateway.

Digital Watch Observatory states Comoros is linked to regional and global fibre systems including EASSy, FLY-LION3 and 2Africa, with Moroni a multi-cable landing point (three named systems, one landing point). Page gives no date for the statement beyond published 2024 (its text refers to 2025 events).

The Comorian minister states that 2Africa will be a fourth international submarine cable joining those already operational, i.e. three in service; the cables and landing stations are not named. Document date used as the statement date.
